name: Sword_Light_1
note: light 1: forehand diagonal R->L; frame 15 == Sword_Light_2 frame 0

name: Sword_Light_2
note: light 2: backhand rising L->R; frame 0 == Sword_Light_1 frame 15, frame 14 == Sword_Light_3 frame 0

name: Sword_Light_3
note: light 3: horizontal R->L at chest height; frame 0 == Sword_Light_2 frame 14, frame 15 == Sword_Light_4 frame 0

name: Sword_Light_4
note: light 4 (finisher): lunging thrust; frame 0 == Sword_Light_3 frame 15; commit, no chain

name: Sword_Light_1_Upper
note: light 1: forehand diagonal R->L; frame 15 == Sword_Light_2 frame 0 | upper-body layer variant (hip yaw folded into the spine)

name: Sword_Light_2_Upper
note: light 2: backhand rising L->R; frame 0 == Sword_Light_1 frame 15, frame 14 == Sword_Light_3 frame 0 | upper-body layer variant (hip yaw folded into the spine)

name: Sword_Light_3_Upper
note: light 3: horizontal R->L at chest height; frame 0 == Sword_Light_2 frame 14, frame 15 == Sword_Light_4 frame 0 | upper-body layer variant (hip yaw folded into the spine)

name: Sword_Light_4_Upper
note: light 4 (finisher): lunging thrust; frame 0 == Sword_Light_3 frame 15; commit, no chain | upper-body layer variant (hip yaw folded into the spine)

name: Hit_Light_Front
note: victim reaction to a hit from the front (push (0.0, 1.0))

name: Hit_Heavy_Front
note: victim reaction to a hit from the front (push (0.0, 1.0))

name: Hit_Light_Back
note: victim reaction to a hit from the back (push (0.0, -1.0))

name: Hit_Heavy_Back
note: victim reaction to a hit from the back (push (0.0, -1.0))

name: Hit_Light_Left
note: victim reaction to a hit from the left (push (-1.0, 0.0))

name: Hit_Heavy_Left
note: victim reaction to a hit from the left (push (-1.0, 0.0))

name: Hit_Light_Right
note: victim reaction to a hit from the right (push (1.0, 0.0))

name: Hit_Heavy_Right
note: victim reaction to a hit from the right (push (1.0, 0.0))

name: Stagger_Back
note: heavy stagger backwards, 0.63 m of pelvis travel (feet travel with it): drive the capsule 0.63 m back over 0.8 s or use root motion

name: Stagger_Forward
note: heavy stagger forwards (hit from behind), 0.63 m of pelvis travel

name: Sword_Parry
note: fast 3-frame snap of the blade up-and-across meeting a blow at f4, small recoil, ready_pose at 0.6 s; rear foot steps back 5 cm at contact; no root motion

name: Sword_Riposte
note: counter after a parry: first frames continue the parry, blade cocks (f2-6), hips lead, front foot steps 0.35 m in (lands f9 with the thrust), rear foot follows f20-25. Root travel 0.35 m forward, ready_pose (relative to root) at 1.1 s

name: Shield_Bash_Step
note: shield arm drives forward at head/chest height with a 0.30 m step-in, shoulder leads, hips turn first, sword arm pulls back as counterweight; contact f10; root travel 0.30 m; ready_pose (relative to root) at 0.9 s

name: Finisher_Stab_Through
note: PAIR with Finisher_Stab_Through_Victim (same 61 frames). Victim root at attacker +1.2 m forward, rotated 180 deg. Thrust through the chest at f14 (tip ~0.3 m past the victim's back), 13 f hold with a twist, pull out + step back. Root travel 0.22 m net (lunge 0.36, steps back to 0.22).

name: Finisher_Stab_Through_Victim
note: PAIR victim of Finisher_Stab_Through (61 frames). Authored in its own frame (faces -Y). The attacker stands 1.2 m in front of it, at local y = -1.2; the blade enters the chest at f14 and its tip ends ~0.5 m behind the victim's pelvis (local +Y). Ends face-down on the ground with the head toward the attacker (local -Y), terminal.

name: Finisher_Overhead_Cleave
note: PAIR with Finisher_Overhead_Cleave_Victim (same 55 frames). Victim (kneeling) root at attacker +1.2 m forward rotated 180 deg. Long overhead windup on the toes (f0-16), 3-frame cleave, blade meets the victim's shoulder/neck line at f20 (tip ~1.15 m ahead of the attacker origin at z ~1.0), overshoot to the ground side. Root travel 0.35 m.

name: Finisher_Overhead_Cleave_Victim
note: PAIR victim of Finisher_Overhead_Cleave (55 frames). Own frame (faces -Y); starts kneeling and swaying; the attacker stands 1.2 m in front (local y = -1.2). Shoulder/neck line at local (x~0, y~-0.1, z~1.0). Collapses sideways onto its left side (+X), terminal.

name: Finisher_Spin_Slash
note: PAIR with Finisher_Spin_Slash_Victim (same 51 frames). Victim root at attacker +1.2 m forward rotated 180 deg. 0.25 m step-in with the front foot, then a 360 deg spin on that planted foot (hips lead, chest lags 1 f, arm whips), horizontal slash through neck/chest height at f16, flourish (blade flick) f26-37. Root travel 0.25 m.

name: Finisher_Spin_Slash_Victim
note: PAIR victim of Finisher_Spin_Slash (51 frames). Own frame (faces -Y); the attacker stands 1.2 m in front at local y = -1.2. Neck/chest line at local z ~1.3-1.5. Twists right on the slash, then falls backwards (+Y local) onto its back, terminal (head at local y ~ +1.3).

name: Sword_Heavy_Charge_Start
note: ready -> deep coiled charge pose (0.33 s); start of the hold loop

name: Sword_Heavy_Charge_Hold
note: charge hold: breathing + arm tremor; first frame == last frame == Charge_Start end pose

name: Sword_Heavy_Release
note: release from the charge pose: hips-led unwind, overhead diagonal cut, lunge 0.45 m

name: Sword_Run_Attack
note: played at ~6 m/s: starts mid-stride (right foot forward), jump-step, skid 1.6 m decelerating, rising diagonal cut; first frame is a running pose (blend from the run cycle), last frame == ready_pose

name: TwoHand_Overhead
note: two-hander overhead chop: 12 f rising anticipation, moving hold, 3 f chop with 0.35 m step-in, ground bounce; left hand grabs the hilt 0.11 m below the right during the wind-up and lets go in the recovery

name: Spear_Thrust_1
note: quick jab from the spear guard, 0.25 m step-in

name: Spear_Thrust_2
note: retract to the hip, hip-driven twisting thrust, 0.35 m step-in

name: Spear_Thrust_3
note: finisher: low-to-high sweeping arc into a lunging long thrust, 0.5 m step

name: Bow_Draw
note: ready -> nock -> full draw side-on (0.53 s); ends at the Hold pose

name: Bow_Hold
note: full draw held, breathing + 1-2 mm tremor; first == last == Bow_Draw end

name: Bow_Loose
note: string released on f1: draw hand flies back past the ear, bow arm kicks forward/down 2-3 deg, follow-through, then back to bow_ready (0.6 s)

name: Bow_Aim_Up
note: full draw aimed +35 deg up (spine bends), 0.1 s pose

name: Bow_Aim_Down
note: full draw aimed -30 deg down, 0.1 s pose

name: Death_1H_Front
note: sword+shield: hit from the front. Recoil, knees buckle, twist, sword hand opens, falls on the back (1.6 s); 0.56 m of pelvis travel backwards; terminal: lying on the back, head +Y

name: Death_1H_Back
note: sword+shield: hit from behind. Arches, arms fly back, one stumbling step forward, knees, falls face-down (1.8 s); 0.5 m of pelvis travel forward; terminal: lying face-down, head -Y

name: Death_2H_Knees
note: two-hand sword: gut hit, drops to both knees, leans on the sword planted point-down for a beat, slides off to the left and lies on its side (2.2 s); 0.4 m travel; terminal: lying on the left side, head +X

name: Death_Bow_Side
note: bow: arrow/hit from the left. Body spins 90 deg away (chest first), bow flies out, legs fold, collapses on the right side (1.5 s); 0.43 m travel; terminal: lying on the right side, head +Y
